sub_answers.text: In 1980 the Australian Government established a national advisory committee on sports for disabled persons and John Grant was a member of that committee [d37675808s4p0]. John Grant wrote to the Minister for Sport, Bob Ellicott, in 1980 arguing the case for a national policy on sport for people with disabilities, which preceded the committee's formation [d37675808s4p0].
